UnitDefinition.Name: Consumer product multiple survey matching method
UnitDefinition.Description: Method types for consumer product individuals when multiple survey are loaded, matching based on gender and and ages that are closest together.

Unit.Name: Match on gender
Unit.Description: Match individuals to assessments based on gender.

Unit.Name: Match on age
Unit.Description: Matching of individuals is based on the ages that are closest together.

Unit.Name: Match on gender and age
Unit.Description: Match individuals to assessments based on gender and ages that are closest together.
